context_for_next_testing_agent: Sonography Cron Reminders feature fully tested and working. The cron endpoint at POST /api/cron/sonography-reminders sends: 1) 24h reminders for tomorrow's bookings, 2) 1h reminders for bookings 45-75 minutes away. Duplicate prevention via reminder_24h_sent and reminder_1h_sent flags. Scheduler.py can be run with 'python scheduler.py --once' for testing.
